chapter: Sidney Bechet and the Paris festival
title: Playing the Paris festival with Hot Lips Page and Don Byas
summary: Moore's group at the festival included Hot Lips Page, Don Byas and pianist Bernard Peiffer.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So when you played there, what groups did you play in, what settings actually did you play in?

At the Festival of Jazz, the producers put me in with Hot Lips Page. The front line was myself, Hot Lips Page and Don Byas and a French rhythm section. I think the piano player, he was pretty famous in France. His name is Bernard Peiffer.
Peiffer, yeh, he was the piano player.
He eventually came to this country and he lived around Camden and Philadelphia for a while.
Right. I wonder where he is now.
He died a couple years ago.

Oh, no, that's too bad. I didn't know that. But he was the piano player there at the Festival and Bechet had his group, he was using Claude Luter and Luter had his band intact. So there was no American musicians with Bechet at this Festival.
Okay, so Charlie Parker was there.
